name: wavespeed
description: Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) on the WaveSpeed platform: live catalog search, per-model schema, local-file upload, price quotes before running.
author: WaveSpeedAI

interface.shortDescription: AI image, video, audio and 3D generation from Kimi Code — every model on WaveSpeed is one call.
interface.longDescription: Adds the WaveSpeed platform to Kimi Code. The bundled MCP server exposes search_models, get_model_schema, get_price, upload_file, run_model, get_prediction and get_balance, and the bundled skill teaches the agent the find → inspect → run workflow on the open-source wavespeed CLI, including uploading local files and quoting prices before spending credits. One `wavespeed login` authenticates both.

skillInstructions: The WaveSpeed MCP tools (search_models, get_model_schema, get_price, upload_file, run_model, get_prediction, get_balance) are the same operations as the CLI recipes in this skill. Prefer the MCP tools for single generations; fall back to the wavespeed CLI when it is installed and the user wants batch or scripted runs. Never ask the user to paste an API key into the chat.
